page.notes: Text is faint in places; the Greek in the footnote (ὁδηγός, Anastasii title) is a best reading. Marginal reference marks f, g, h appear in the text as superscripts and are kept as printed. Footnote 'Vide Jumum' may be a misprint for Vide Turrianum or similar; left as printed-appearing.
